delay before bonus heal/shield is applied
values.binNote: No bin row for this delay was found among the listed NilahPassive data values; the wiki text is the only source for it.

values.meaning: maximum duration of the bonus shield
values.quote: up to a maximum duration of 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: Nilah gains a bonus portion of any healing or shielding a nearby ally applies to themselves or to Nilah, and vice versa.
mechanics.quote: Whenever a nearby allied champion uses an ability to heal or shield either Nilah or themselves, both they and Nilah receive a bonus amount

mechanics.claim: Item, rune, and summoner spell heals/shields do not trigger the bonus.
mechanics.quote: Heal and shields granted by [[item]]s, [[rune]]s, and [[summoner spell]]s will '''not''' trigger the increased amount.

mechanics.claim: The bonus heal/shield effect does not trigger itself recursively.
mechanics.quote: The heal and shield increases do not trigger from their own heal or shield.

mechanics.claim: Killing a minion grants Nilah and the nearest ally champion 50% of the shared experience they would otherwise lose.
mechanics.quote: gain an additional {{sti|{{as|50% of the experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing
